_comment: The ANDROID AD-CARRYING wrapper's configuration - the sibling of
packaging/ios/capacitor.config.json, and NOT the TWA in packaging/twa/.
This shell exists for exactly one reason: an ad SDK is native code and a
TWA cannot carry any (see README.md in this folder). Same rules as iOS:
webDir points at the BUILT ASSETS so the app ships them in its bundle,
and there is no 'server' block at all - adding one turns this back into
a browser pointed at a website.
The appId MUST stay com.phaserugbymanager.app: Play identifies the app
by id, so the wrapper replaces the TWA as an update, keeping installs,
reviews and purchase history. It must be signed with the same upload key.
backgroundColor is the night ground from src/ui/tokens.css. It has to
match or a white frame flashes between the launch screen and first paint.
